quotes.text: 这里刚好有一个新的变化，9月18号日本央行已经公布结果， 加息25个基点，把政策利率提高到1.25， 日元却在决定公布后走弱， 因为这次加息基本符合预期，加上有两名日本央行的委员反对加息， 市场没有得到更强硬的信号。 亚德里在采访里面说的很具体，如果只加息25个基点， 套息交易的退出可能还比较平缓，如果突然加息50个基点呢， 冲击就可能被放大，现在公布的是25， 所以呢眼前啊没有出现雅德里设想的 那个突然加50个基点的冲击。接下来我们要观察的是日本还会加多快， 日元会不会持续的升值，以及借钱买资产的资金
quotes.translation: There is a new development here: on September 18, the Bank of Japan announced its decision to raise interest rates by 25 basis points, bringing the policy rate to 1.25%. However, the yen weakened after the decision was announced because this rate hike was largely in line with expectations, and with two Bank of Japan board members opposing the hike, the market did not receive a more hawkish signal. Yardeni was very specific in his interview: if they only raise rates by 25 basis points, the exit from the carry trade might be relatively smooth; if they suddenly raise rates by 50 basis points, the shock could be amplified. Now that 25 has been announced, we aren't seeing the shock of a sudden 50-basis-point hike that Yardeni envisioned.
